test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All students are teachers.

All teachers are humans.

**Conclusions:**

I. All teachers are students.

II. All humans are students.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7a94f128fc166839c1668503d0107faba6f7813224c79f22c39a4d20e2c810c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All teachers are students →Does not follow →** **(As all teachers are students is **false** because All students are teachers and some teachers are students follow)

II. All humans are students → Does not follow → (As all humans are students is false because All humans are students and some humans are students follow)

Thus, neither Conclusion I nor Conclusion II follow.

Hence, "**Neither conclusion I nor II follows" **is the correct answer.
